name: Carpipramine
summary: Carpipramine (Prazinil, Defekton) is an atypical antipsychotic used for the treatment of schizophrenia and anxiety in France and Japan. In addition to its neuroleptic and anxiolytic effects, carpipramine also has hypnotic properties. It is structurally related to both tricyclics like imipramine and butyrophenones like haloperidol.

uses.text: Carpipramine (Prazinil, Defekton) is an atypical antipsychotic used for the treatment of schizophrenia and anxiety in France and Japan.

sideEffects.en: Little detailed information is available in English. Antipsychotics in general can cause drowsiness, dizziness, weight gain and movement problems such as stiffness and restlessness.
sideEffects.zh: 英文資料中關於它的詳細資訊很少。一般來說，抗精神病藥可能造成嗜睡、頭暈、體重增加，以及僵硬、坐立不安等動作問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 英文数据中关于它的详细信息很少。一般来说，抗精神病药可能造成嗜睡、头晕、体重增加，以及僵硬、坐立不安等动作问题。

fact.en: Carpipramine is a hybrid molecule: it has the three-ring core of the antidepressant imipramine joined to a side chain like those of the butyrophenone antipsychotics such as haloperidol.
fact.zh: Carpipramine 是一種混合型分子：它具有抗憂鬱藥丙咪嗪的三環核心，再接上類似氟哌啶醇等丁醯苯類抗精神病藥的側鏈。
fact.zhHans: Carpipramine 是一种混合型分子：它具有抗忧郁药丙咪嗪的三环内核，再接上类似氟哌啶醇等丁酰苯类抗精神病药的侧链。
